title: Focused at launch
statement: The app shall open with the new-task field focused, so that typing a title and pressing return adds the task to the Inbox.

title: Task fields
statement: A task shall have a title, an optional note, an optional due date and a done flag, and no other user-visible field.

title: The Inbox
statement: Every account shall have exactly one Inbox list, which can be neither deleted nor renamed.

title: Manual order
statement: Tasks in a list shall keep the order the user gave them, with every done task after every open one.

title: One notification per due task
statement: The app shall keep exactly one pending local notification for each open task with a due date, and none for any other task.

title: Snooze times
statement: Snoozing shall reschedule a reminder to 10 minutes from now, to 1 hour from now, or to 09:00 local time on the next day.

title: Merging a downloaded task
statement: The app shall merge a downloaded `Task` record into the local task field by field, keeping each field's later value.

title: No analytics
statement: The app shall link no analytics, crash-reporting or advertising SDK.
